newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.88 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.88 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 101.62824 UDIs and a real return of 6.88 percent at the primary auction on Monday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds also had a real return of 6.88 percent.
Demand this week was 1.29 billion UDIs compared to 350 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.69.
Two weeks ago demand was 1.04 billion UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.47.
The daily value of the UDI can be found on MXAAN.
